gloss: to wake up, to get up

definitions.gloss: to wake up, to get up
definitions.explanation: Used when waking up from sleep or getting out of bed.
Used to describe events or incidents occurring.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{六時|ろくじ}に{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}は{早|はや}く{起|お}きました。
examples.english: I woke up early this morning.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}が{起|お}きたんですか。

notes: 起きる is an ichidan verb (ru-verb) that can mean both 'to wake up' and 'to occur/happen.' The transitive pair is 起こす (okosu, to wake someone up). Conjugation: 起きない (negative), 起きます (polite), 起きた (past).
